en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5393 - Jameel ibn Darraj narrated from some of our companions from one of the two Imams (as) regarding a man who broke another man's hand, and then the man's hand healed.
Imam (as) said: "There is no retaliation (qisas) in this case, but he must pay compensation (Al-arsh)."
